name: VM Designation
description: What a person does, as a picklist rather than free text. Designations are typed once by an admin and chosen everywhere else: the people using this app are not typists, and 'Sr. Tech'/'Senior Technician'/'sr tech' in a Data field would make the org chart unreportable within a week.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Cleared rather than deleted when a role is retired, so people who already hold it keep a readable designation.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower sorts first in the app's picker. Ties fall back to alphabetical.
